sql: WITH bc AS (SELECT DISTINCT c.bond_id, CASE WHEN a1.element < a2.element THEN a1.element || '-' || a2.element ELSE a2.element || '-' || a1.element END AS combo FROM connected c JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id), cnt AS (SELECT combo, COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) AS n FROM bc GROUP BY combo ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT 100.0 * n / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) FROM bc) AS percentage FROM cnt
